        <h3>Bioinformatics bootcamps</h3>
        <p>Intensive multi-week, hands-on programmes in Linux, R, Python, RNA-seq and reproducible workflows. No prior programming background assumed.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="../training/">See programmes →</a>
      </div>
      <div class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Format · Seminar</span>
        <h3>Research seminars</h3>
        <p>Talks from members and invited researchers on methods and results, with time given to the parts that did not work.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="mailto:chiralbd@gmail.com?subject=Seminar%20invitation">Propose a talk →</a>
      </div>
      <div class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Format · Journal club</span>
        <h3>Journal club</h3>
        <p>Students present a recent paper and are expected to criticise its design, not just summarise its findings. This is where most members learn to read properly.</p>
        <a class="c-card-link" href="../opportunities/">Join the centre →</a>
      </div>
    </div>
